title: Gear inspection and retirement criteria
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. REQ-D3 requires retirement after any arrest event and a marked service life; rental fleets need inspection checklists. Risk tier high: requires credentialed expert review before release.
objective: Write inspection checklists (before each use, periodic, after an event) and retirement criteria for each product, using fall-protection inspection practice as a reference.
acceptanceCriteria: Criteria cover webbing, stitching, hardware, absorber indicator, tag and labels
Retirement after any arrest event stated as absolute
Merged as DRAFT only (banner intact); release requires MVP-gate Safety Engineer sign-off (GOVERNANCE.md)
